root.name: English Opening: Closed, Taimanov Variation
root.moves: 1. c4 e5 2. Nc3 Nc6 3. g3 g6 4. Rb1 Nh6 5. Bg2 Bg7

overview: White plays a Reversed Closed Sicilian with g3 and Bg2, while Black develops with ...Nc6, ...g6, ...Bg7 and a quirky ...Nh6 to aim at f5 or d4. The Taimanov Variation keeps pieces flexible; White usually plays d3 or e3, Nge2 and castles, with Rb1 and b4 as a queenside expansion. Slow manoeuvring play.

white_ideas.idea: Play Bg2, e3 or d3, Nge2 and O-O, preparing b4 with Rb1.
Control d5 and keep options of d4.

black_ideas.idea: Maintain the e5 pawn and play ...Be6 or ...f5.

typical_structures.structure: Reversed Closed Sicilian with White c4/g3/e3 and Black e5/d6 with Nh6 and Bg7.

character.notes: Slow manoeuvring game with fianchetto structures and little forcing play.

structure.notes: English with a tense centre and no pawn contact; flexible.

approach.notes: A mainstream English line used by strong players.

sublines_that_differ.how: The listed root; 4.Rb1 prepares b4 early, while the commonly played line is 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.e3.
